name: agent-kit-unity
description: MCP-agnostic Unity conventions + Editor-routing kit for AI coding agents, shipped as a project-scoped Oh My Pi kit. Teaches Unity conventions and routes Editor operations to whatever Unity MCP is connected (install any; most share the same core capabilities); ships Unity-domain skills and rules plus the Luna playable-ads pipeline. Activates only in a repo's .omp/; silent elsewhere.

scripts.lint: npm run lint:loc && npm run lint:frontmatter && npm run lint:docs-counts
